title: Job Safety Analysis - Emergency Rescue
description: Free Job Safety Analysis - Emergency Rescue template for mining you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers incident information, critical incident command & safety briefing, rescue operations sequence and hazard analysis.
topics: Rescue Operations Sequence And Hazard Analysis

Rescue Operations Sequence And Hazard Analysis

OPERATION STEPPOTENTIAL HAZARDSHAZARD CATEGORYRISK LEVEL (H/M/L)CONTROL MEASURESRESPONSIBLE PERSONSIGN-OFF
1. Team Assembly & Briefing-Rushing in without plan
-Incomplete information
-Wrong equipment
-Team not briefed		Multiple Multiple Multiple MultipleH H H H-Size-up from safe location
-Gather all available information

2. Staging & Equipment Check-Equipment malfunction
-Inadequate supplies
-SCBA cylinder low
-Communication failure		Multiple Multiple Respiratory MultipleM H H H-Check all equipment before deployment
-Spare cylinders staged
-Test comms before entry		Staging Officer Rescue Team
3. Approach & Access (to casualty)-Ground fall
-Toxic atmosphere
-Visibility poor
-Unstable ground		Struck By Respiratory Fall/Trip Ground FailureH H M H-Proceed cautiously
-Continuous monitoring
-Use guide lines in zero visibility
-Check ground stability continuously		Rescue Team Leader Team Members
4. Casualty Assessment & Stabilize-Further injury to casualty
-Team member injury
-Hazards to rescuers during treatment		Medical Multiple MultipleH H H-Rapid but careful extrication
-C-spine control if spinal injury suspected
-Continuous hazard assessment		Rescue Team Medic
5. Extrication & Movement-Manual handling injuries
-Dropping casualty
-Further entrapment
-Equipment snagging		Ergonomics Fall Medical MultipleM H M M-Team lifting
-Use stretcher/ basket
-Clear path before moving
-Secure casualty in stretcher		Rescue Team Leader
6. Transport to Staging/ Medical-Deteriorating conditions
-Team fatigue
-Communication loss
-Delay in handover		Multiple Health Multiple MedicalH M H M-Continuous monitoring
-Team rotation if prolonged
-Backup comms
-Update medical facility		Rescue Team Leader Medic
7. Debrief & Critical Incident Stress Debriefing-Stress/ trauma
-Missed information
-Equipment not replenished		Mental Health Multiple OperationalM M L-Critical incident stress debriefing (CISD)
-Equipment check and replenish		Incident Commander Team Leader
